primary.holdout: Algorithm frozen before evaluation on seeds 1760..1769; no tuning on held-out outcomes
primary.statistics: 4000-draw paired seed percentile bootstrap; RNG 4099; exploratory, no multiplicity correction
limits: Synthetic finite-buffer two-path fluid traffic; no physical packets
Only prior completed episodes train A4; no candidate outcome evaluation
A4 retains up to 96 magnitude-preserving action-specific episodes; A3 retains 30
The guard-only H1 is the no-memory ablation
O1 has privileged same-window simulator access; not a deployable or long-horizon upper bound
P95 is over mean-window delay, not individual packets
Local computation timings exclude final memory flush; network results alone do not benchmark LLM quality

legacy.label: Two serial calls with full prompts

compact.label: One compact call and local reflection

hybrid.label: Compact call with validated local reuse

limits: Different call counts and local reuse are explicit system changes, not proof of faster provider servers
Transport time includes HTTP/network/service time; pacing is recorded separately
Full control time includes reflection; no work is silently moved outside the measured interval
Seed order reverses mode order to reduce time-order bias; provider variation remains
Failures and local cache/bypass/memory origins remain in all metrics

sensitivity.design: Post-hoc constructed mechanism stress test; excluded from the primary eight-scenario average
sensitivity.hypothesis: A tiny overload can make a fixed 20% meter cost more goodput than its delay benefit; action-local negative episodes should reject it
